entries.answer: First I listen to the customer fully without interrupting and say sorry for the trouble. I ask for the bill and check if the item is under warranty. If it is, I offer a replacement or repair as per store policy; if I can't decide, I call the store manager. I stay polite even if they shout and make sure they leave with a clear solution and date.
I will put ₹200 from my own pocket so nobody finds out and there is no problem.

I ask what they will use it for and what their budget is. Then I explain the main differences between the two in simple words and let them hold and try both. I recommend the one that fits their need, even if it's the cheaper one, and mention the warranty and return policy.
My hobbies are cricket and music. I am a fresher.

I would never argue with the customer or blame them. I'd calmly say sorry, look at the bill and get it exchanged or repaired.
